settings.install.installed: ProseCraft is installed and running as an app on this device. The app shell opens offline; your projects stay in this device’s local database.

settings.data.sectionHelp: Back up or move your projects between devices
settings.data.localStorageHelp: Projects are stored in this app's local database.
settings.data.epubHelp: Creates a new project from an EPUB file. Chapter structure and supported illustrations are preserved, and the cover becomes the project cover when it can be embedded.

settings.data.syncDriveHelp: Keep this device in sync through Google Drive. Projects are encrypted with your passphrase before they are stored in your app data folder.
settings.data.syncSingleFileHelp: All projects in one passphrase-protected file. Best for cloud folders and Google Drive.
settings.data.syncOpenFolderHelp: Plain Markdown and JSON, one folder per project. Not encrypted.
settings.data.syncEncryptedFolderHelp: One encrypted file per project record. Keeps existing sync folders working.
